name: rw4b-e1-lev-vt25-g200-brake-v1
description: DRAFT PRE-REGISTRATION (2026-10-23), docs/reports/RW-reescritura-rentable.md §14 (RW4b, the condition of the Q3 quorum, docs/reports/Q3-quorum-decision.md): leveraged E1 with a drawdown brake and a faster vol estimator. Evaluated by backtest now; its WIRING is decided only when the 90-day freeze ends (2027-01-21), against E1's live record and only if E1's live Sharpe and beta stay inside the backtest band. momentum_stocks' own 11 names, the RW2 E1 volManaged construction byte for byte (1/sigma 63d, 21d covariance, cap 0.25, band 1%, 5 USD fractional) with the RW3 axes vol target 25% and maxGross 2 (Reg-T margin at 6.5%/yr on the borrowed cash, base and stress) plus a drawdown brake on the target vol (linear from 1 at a 5% sleeve drawdown to 0.25 at 20%, restored as it recovers; peak of the sleeve's book equity tracked in memory at past decisions, no look-ahead) and a fast vol estimate (portfolio vol for the scale = max of the 5-day and the 21-day covariance estimates). Pure chain of 1 candidate so the OOS frontier point is read directly. Window, asOf, costs and capital = rw2-e1-stocks-volmanaged-v1, so the OOS sessions are those of the control (E1 re-run 33b0ac05, passed as --control) and E2 (artifact 0b088ca3, passed as --partner, the account's other $50k). Binding criteria §14: R1-R7 (R2 = the 25% sleeve drawdown limit, R3 = Sharpe not below E1's on the same days) plus A1 account drawdown <= 20%, H1/H2 with a -0.18 Sharpe haircut, M1 margin cost >= 6.5%, S1/S2 the February-March 2020 and 2022 windows judged separately. Pre-registered pick among the family's passing chains: highest CAGR, ties to lower maxDD. The brake and fast-vol parameters are fixed here, a priori, not tuned. Trials 426 -> 427.
